scenes.title: Citizen Ingress & Zero-Typing UI
scenes.voiceover_text: In Tamil Nadu, 80 million citizens navigate complex government entitlements every day. But for millions of rural farmers, weavers, and elders, literacy barriers and corrupt middlemen extort thousands of rupees for services that legally cost just ₹60. Meet Makkal Agent AI—a sovereign multimodal action agent designed from the ground up with zero typing required.

scenes.title: Citizen Workstation & WhatsApp Passwordless Access
scenes.voiceover_text: Authentication requires no cumbersome usernames or passwords. Citizens simply send a 4-digit PIN via WhatsApp to instantly unlock their sovereign workstation. Here, our farmer Subramanian accesses his encrypted Life Vault—housing his Aadhaar, Smart Ration card, and registered property deeds, while our real-time counter tracks over ₹64 Lakhs in extortion prevented across his district.

scenes.title: Computer Vision Forensic: Physical Deed Audit
scenes.voiceover_text: When Subramanian purchases 80 cents of agricultural land, how does he verify his deed? Powered by Meta SAM 3.1 and SAM 2, our multimodal vision pipeline segments the physical deed in 218 milliseconds—verifying the Government Ashoka Emblem at 99.8% confidence, confirming the Sub-Registrar wet stamp under Section 17, and validating survey boundaries to ensure zero tampering.

scenes.title: Cadastral FMB Survey Subdivision Triangulation
scenes.meta_ai_model: Autonomous Vector CAD Engine (TN Survey Act 1923)
scenes.voiceover_text: Land mutation requires cadastral precision. Our autonomous engine generates authentic Field Measurement Book vector plots under the Tamil Nadu Survey Act 1923. It calculates exact G-line triangulation metrics, clearly separating Parent Patta Plot A from Subramanian’s new Plot B—preventing costly boundary encroachment disputes before revenue registration.

scenes.title: Statutory Legal Reasoning & Court-Ready PDF
scenes.voiceover_text: Next, Meta Muse Wonder 1.0 executes a 5-step statutory deliberation over Tamil Nadu Revenue Standing Order 31. It generates a court-ready, printable Revenue Petition addressed directly to the Vadipatti Taluk Tahsildar—complete with Madras High Court precedents and an encrypted government barcode, legally locking the service fee at just ₹60.

scenes.title: Civic Infra Sentinel: Road Hazard Segmentation
scenes.voiceover_text: Makkal Agent AI also protects citizen safety on the roads. Using SAM 2 and Llama 3.2 Vision, our Civic Sentinel segments asphalt road craters from citizen camera photos. It quantifies 1.05 square meters of damage, computes 0.31 tons of cold-mix asphalt required, and auto-dispatches an official repair order to the State Highways Department.

scenes.title: Anti-Usury Engine: Predatory Loan Neutralizer
scenes.voiceover_text: In rural communities, predatory moneylenders trap families with illegal Kandhuvatti loans at 120% annual interest. Our Llama Stack anti-usury tool neutralizes the extortion—enforcing Tamil Nadu Act 38 of 2003 to cap interest at the legal 9%, saving Subramanian ₹92,500 and generating an immediate police complaint.

scenes.title: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API Pipeline
scenes.meta_ai_model: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API v21.0 & SeamlessM4T
scenes.tooltip: Voice Note Ingress to WhatsApp PDF Return
scenes.voiceover_text: Best of all, citizens don't need to install any new app. Through the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, Subramanian simply sends a 14-second voice note in his native colloquial Tamil. SeamlessM4T transcribes his dialect, and within 4.1 seconds, the official court petition PDF is delivered straight back into his WhatsApp chat.

scenes.title: Multi-Model Cognitive Telemetry & Benchmarks
scenes.voiceover_text: Under the hood, six synchronized Meta AI foundation models orchestrate legal reasoning, visual segmentation, and speech recognition—validated against 691 domain training samples with a 100% legal accuracy benchmark.

scenes.title: Future Vision: Scaling Across 1.4 Billion Citizens
scenes.voiceover_text: Our vision extends beyond Tamil Nadu: scaling SeamlessM4T across all 22 Indian regional languages, deploying on-device offline Llama 3.2 edge inference, and bringing sovereign digital justice to 1.4 billion citizens. Makkal Agent AI—transforming democracy through Meta AI.
